result.changelog:
All error, unverified, missing and keys items from the report were applied. Sources checked: Metroid Wiki (Reptilicus Hunter, Lightbringer, Genesis Chamber, Tangle Weed, Corruption and Hunters Logbooks, Glider, Luminoth, Steambot, Steamlord, Phaaze, Sheegoth, Valhalla category), Wikipedia (Prime 4, Federation Force) and the Omega Metroid biology and machines guides.
- Aether: Luminoth called settlers, not natives. Lightbringers moved to the Dark Agon Wastes as bio-engineered foragers. Darklings now include natives such as Nightbarbs. Krocuss wording fixed; the Grenchler commentary is gone.
- Alimbic: Voldrum weaknesses corrected (Electro falls to rapid fire). The claim that the Alimbics seeded animals was softened. The 'only record' line was deleted. Psycho Bit locations widened; Guardians now described as Alimbic guards. The Quadtroid Arcterra location was dropped.
- Bryyo: Reptilicus Hunters are now Phazon-corrupted, with no 'chosen' origin. Hopper, Warp Hound, Fargul Hatcher, Gel Ray and Shelbug were rebuilt from the Logbook. Unconfirmed venom and thermal-blast details were removed.
- Elysia: Elysians are now the Chozo-built mechanoids themselves. Steamlords are corrupted Elysians, Tinbots converted Elysians. Phazon Metroids are 'held', not 'bred'.
- Phaaze: added Phazon Hoppers and Hopping Metroids (Drop Shaft) and Jelsacs, Phazon Metroids and Miniroids (Genesis Chamber). Grub life cycle fixed; the husks now 'resemble' Metroid Prime. Samus's arrival now follows the permanent-Hypermode account.
- Bermuda: Goliath Beetle description and 'alongside the Pirates' removed. Egg scene corrected. Unverified 'captured and brainwashed', 'once Federation territory' and the General's name removed. Secondary keys cut to 8.
- Viewros: cause of the aggression changed to Green Energy. 'Viewros incident' replaced by the Tanamaar arrival. Machine origins fixed (Flight Drones and Mecha Rats from the Volt Forge factory AI). Keratos, Phenoros and Carvex Metroid-fusion details added. Dartwing, Winged Lizard and Crystal Crawler wording fixed. The unverified Swim Snatcher Energy Tank theft and Varmis timing were removed.
- Tallon IV: Triclops and Flickerbat nits fixed.
- Keys: generic keys removed (Glider, Puffer, Hopper, Darkling, Lightbringer, Shrieker, Splinters, Snatchers, Snow Wolf, Winged Lizard, G.F.S. Valhalla, Zoomer, Geemer).
- Length: entries trimmed to 390-410 words, except Tallon IV (472) and Viewros (506), which are treated as the biggest subjects.
result.unresolved:
- Key counts: seven entries keep 18-22 primary keys, above the general 3-12 limit. The draft says the domain brief asks for each species name plus its plural; every key kept is a distinctive species name or a multi-word phrase.
- Single source for Viewros: most Viewros species rest only on the Omega Metroid Logbook guide. Re-verify them once Metroid Wiki covers Viewros.
- Names without descriptions: Jelsacs and Phazon Hoppers are attested only by name, so the entries name them without describing them.
- Thin Federation Force record: Goliath Beetles are named only on Wikipedia.
- Unchecked but kept: a few details I did not re-fetch myself (Steamlord encounter specifics, Shriekbat body temperature) stay because the fact-checker marked them accurate.
- Search: WebSearch was not used.
